title: HomeShopList: Shopping Lists
short_description: Your Home Assistant shopping list on phone and watch – live, sorted by aisle.
full_description:
HomeShopList brings the shopping and to-do lists of your Home Assistant to your phone and your Wear OS watch. Changes appear live – whatever is added at home shows up in the store a moment later, without refreshing.

SHOPPING LIST
• Works with every Home Assistant to-do list – pick the one you want
• Add, check off, rename and delete items in seconds
• Suggestions from your previous purchases while typing, with their store section
• Delete all completed items at once

SORTED LIKE YOUR STORE
• Assign a store section to each item – fruit & vegetables, bakery, dairy, frozen and more, each with its own icon
• Simple list or grouped by section
• Reorder items and move them between sections with drag & drop
• Choose which sections are shown and arrange them to match your route through the store

WATCH (WEAR OS)
• Your list on your wrist: check off items while your hands are full
• Delete completed items right on the watch
• Tile with the number of open items and a progress ring
• No setup on the watch: it takes over the connection from your phone

SETTINGS AND BACKUP
• Settings in clear tabs: Connection, View, Data
• Back up connection, store sections and suggestions to a password-encrypted file and restore them
• Follows your system's light or dark mode
• Available in 13 languages

PRIVACY
HomeShopList talks only to your own Home Assistant. No ads, no account, no data sent to external servers. Address, token and suggestions stay on your device. With a watch, the phone passes the connection to it via Google Play services. For local http:// addresses, the app warns you before your token is sent unencrypted. HomeShopList is open source (MIT license).

Requirements: Android 7.0 or newer, Home Assistant 2023.11 or newer with a to-do list (e.g. the Shopping List integration) and a long-lived access token.
For the watch: a Wear OS watch paired with an Android phone running HomeShopList.

HomeShopList is an independent project and is not affiliated with Home Assistant or Nabu Casa. Home Assistant is a trademark of its respective owner.
